capabilities.description: Prepare, execute, independently evaluate and summarize bounded native iOS development, review, testing, accessibility and distribution-preparation work using workflows/WORKFLOW.md and templates/DELIVERY.md. Establish actual native iOS targets and deployment compatibility before dependent actions; Swift files or task-type selection alone do not admit macOS-only, server Swift, watchOS-only or unverified-platform work. Preserve existing SwiftUI/UIKit architecture, state/lifecycle ownership and concurrency boundaries; inspect applicable persistence, networking, secrets, privacy and consent behavior. Produce scoped changes or evidence-backed findings with actual build/test/accessibility/device configurations and current independent assessment. Review, testing and distribution preparation do not inherently authorize source mutation or release. Keep simulator, physical-device, independent product and release evidence distinct; archive validation is limited screening. This single reusable lifecycle capability declares no mandatory cross-Domain capability dependency; prepare verifies actual project/task prerequisites and authority. Source IDs resolve in evidence/sources.json: [IOS-IDENTITY] [IOS-UI] [IOS-UIKIT] [IOS-STATE] [IOS-CONCURRENCY] [IOS-DATA] [IOS-NETWORK] [IOS-SECRETS] [IOS-PRIVACY] [IOS-CONSENT] [IOS-TEST] [IOS-ACCESSIBILITY] [IOS-DEVICE] [IOS-DISTRIBUTION].
permissions: Inspect only task-authorized project source, configuration, contracts, maintained tooling and redacted evidence within the prepared scope; sensitive or privileged access requires applicable user and platform authority.

Edit local source, configuration, tests and redacted task evidence only when authorized by the actual task and applicable user/platform permissions; preserve unrelated user changes. Review-only intent requires findings without forced mutation; testing, accessibility and distribution-preparation task labels alone grant no source-edit authority.

Run only task-authorized checks using procedures and tools discovered from actual project documentation/configuration and verified available Xcode or other project tooling. Verify commands, supported configurations, data, services and destination access before dependent execution; an empty tools list promises no installed command and grants no tool access.

Signing, entitlement or provisioning changes, account/team access or changes, physical-device access or changes, archive/distribution, external mutation, publication, commit and push require actual action-specific task/user authorization and applicable platform authority. Capability selection, Domain activation and distribution preparation imply none of these permissions.

Stop only dependent actions when native admission, compatibility, required prerequisites or authority are absent or unverified; record the concrete block or needs-org-input and continue independently authorized inspection/checks. Never invent access, bypass platform controls or substitute local checks for independent, device or release acceptance.
